transcript: Tócame, tócame, tócame, tócame que yo me muero. Bésame, bésame, bésame, bésame que desespero. Amame, amame, amame, amame siendo el primero.
baselinePrompt:
Bright, clean home interior with white walls and soft diffused natural light — a minimal, airy grooming environment. [INFLUENCER] is shirtless throughout, wearing a thin silver chain necklace with a small red horn pendant and a second delicate chain layered beneath it, plus a small hoop earring.

The clip opens as the scroll-stopping hook: a tight close-up on [INFLUENCER]'s face as he uses one hand to vigorously work a white creamy hair product through his hair, shampoo-like lather streaking down his forehead. He stares directly into the lens with a composed, slightly smouldering expression. He then tilts his head downward, eyes closing, still massaging product through his hair with both hands, lather dripping. The camera stays at close-up portrait distance, handheld, gently drifting.

Cut to him lifting his head again, hair now product-coated, glancing upward with an expressive, slightly exaggerated look while speaking to camera — mouth open mid-word, a hint of a dry-humoured reaction on his face. A light-coloured towel is briefly draped across his shoulder, partially filling the left edge of frame.

Cut to a macro insert shot: two orange-labelled black-lidded hair product jars held up close to the lens in sharp focus, [INFLUENCER] softly blurred in the background. His hands open one lid, scoop a small amount of cream with his fingertips, and begin working it between his fingers. He holds both jars toward camera at various angles while speaking, eyes glancing between the products and the lens. He applies a small amount of the cream to his fingertips and works it through his hair in the background of the shot.

Cut back to a mid close-up of [INFLUENCER] actively styling his hair with his hand — pressing and pushing damp hair back and upward, forehead furrowed with slight concentration, speaking to camera between movements. He runs his open palm firmly back along the top of his head, shaping the style.

Cut to him holding a matte black hair dryer up at head height and directing warm air at his hair, tilting his head and looking sideward and upward with a relaxed, slightly amused expression as he speaks. The diffused window light catches the front of his face cleanly.

Cut to close-up of [INFLUENCER] applying a white shaving cream or beard balm to his jaw and neck area using his open hand, chin raised, head tilted slightly back. He smooths the product deliberately along the jawline, down the neck. He then picks up a gold-handled razor with a multi-blade cartridge head and draws it carefully across his cheek and jaw in controlled downward strokes, chin raised, eyes directed slightly upward, expression calm and focused. The razor leaves a clean strip through the cream with each pass.

Cut to a tight close-up of [INFLUENCER]'s face as he holds a dropper bottle — clear glass pipette with a black rubber bulb — and squeezes a few drops of clear serum directly onto his forehead. He tilts his face slightly upward, watching the dropper intently. Golden-tinted liquid serum beads on his forehead and begins to run down. He then moves the dropper lower, dispensing drops along his cheekbone and temple, tilting his head to the side, neck exposed, chain catching the light.

Cut to him pressing both hands flat against his face, palms covering nose and cheeks, pressing the serum in with deliberate upward and outward massage strokes — eyes closed briefly then opening upward. He works the product across his forehead, cheeks, and jaw with both hands in smooth, practiced motions, talking to camera between strokes.

Cut to a wipe: one hand sweeps quickly across his face in a single brisk motion, a transitional beat.

The clip closes on [INFLUENCER] facing camera in close-up, hair now neatly styled back — clean, finished look — touching his jawline lightly with one hand while speaking, expression shifting from serious and thoughtful into a warm, self-satisfied half-smile, then a full open grin directed straight into the lens. His face is noticeably gleaming from the applied serum. The final beats hold on him smiling and laughing softly at camera, relaxed and confident, blurred soft white wall behind him.
